entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The alien Titans of Zendikar and the armies of drones in their lineages.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi Titan whose lineage has obsidian crowns that are holes into the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi Titan with a lattice-fleshed lineage, drawn to Innistrad by Nahiri.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi Titan whose lineage lacks skin, has bone-plate faces and consumes land, leaving chalky white substance.

entities.name: Kozilek's lineage
entities.description: Eldrazi with floating obsidian crowns, many eyes and warping presence; they leave bismuth-like crystal patterns.

entities.name: Emrakul's lineage
entities.description: Multicolored, tentacled Eldrazi with lattice-like flesh that leave yellow dust.

entities.name: Ulamog's lineage
entities.description: Skinless Eldrazi with bone-plate faces and bifurcated limbs that exist to consume land.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where the three Eldrazi Titans spawned their lineages.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Emrakul corrupted native creatures.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who drew Emrakul to Innistrad.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes revealed through the holes in Kozilek's lineage crowns.

entities.name: Eldrazi Spawn
entities.description: Small Eldrazi that exist to be consumed for mana by larger Eldrazi.

entities.name: Eldrazi Scions
entities.description: Eldrazi that can be consumed as food by other Eldrazi but can also fight; land and aquatic kinds exist.

entities.name: Eternal Scourge
entities.description: The only true Eldrazi of Emrakul's lineage to appear on Innistrad, a drone about the size of a tall human.

entities.name: Nest Invader
entities.description: A small green drone that infiltrates forests and deploys small amounts of spawn.

entities.name: Emrakul's Hatcher
entities.description: A red bear-sized drone that deploys large amounts of spawn to begin a full-scale invasion.

entities.name: Vestige of Emrakul
entities.description: A purple house-sized four-legged drone that is a deadly threat in combat.

entities.name: Hand of Emrakul
entities.description: A huge red Eldrazi able to tear apart huge rocks.

entities.name: Eldrazi Conscription
entities.description: Emrakul's ability to distort the biology of living native creatures into Eldrazi, to which zombies and spirits are immune.

entities.name: Salvage Drone
entities.description: Small drones of Ulamog that help consume land and store material to be recovered when they die.

entities.name: Blisterpod
entities.description: A small drone that spawns an Eldrazi scion when it dies.

entities.name: Sludge Crawler
entities.description: A drone that helps ingest muddy land, named for appearing in swampy areas near Hagra.

entities.name: Reaver Drone
entities.description: A drone that exists to destroy the people who lived on the land.

entities.name: Culling Drone
entities.description: One of the most common Ulamog drones, unleashed in huge hordes across Bala Ged.

entities.name: Fathom Feeder
entities.description: A small Eldrazi adept at infiltrating the seas that kills sea behemoths by consuming their life-force.

entities.name: Forerunner of Slaughter
entities.description: An aggressive drone that makes fellow Eldrazi faster and more aggressive.

entities.name: Mist Intruder
entities.description: The smallest flying species of Ulamog's lineage, used as a scout.

entities.name: Sky Scourer
entities.description: A larger flying drone empowered by nearby Eldrazi that hunts survivors.

entities.name: Tide Drifter
entities.description: An aquatic drone that empowers nearby Eldrazi rather than attacking.

entities.name: Benthic Infiltrator
entities.description: An aquatic drone that slips into areas controlled by the Zendikar Resistance.

entities.name: Zendikar Resistance
entities.description: The resistance against the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

entities.name: Dominator Drone
entities.description: A head-sized parasite that attaches to living creatures, controls them and drains their life.

entities.name: Eldrazi Skyspawner
entities.description: A drone evolved to spread Ulamog's lineage over long distances by creating scions.

entities.name: Flayer Drone
entities.description: A mid-sized four-legged drone with tentacles that attack distant enemies.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: A land on Zendikar consumed by hordes of culling drones.

events.summary: When Nahiri draws Emrakul to Innistrad, most of her spawn stay on Zendikar and Emrakul corrupts native Innistrad creatures into mutated spawn.
events.quote: When Emrakul was drawn to Innistrad by Nahiri, most of her spawns were left on Zendikar.

events.summary: Culling drones are unleashed in huge hordes across Bala Ged, leading to the land's consumption.
events.quote: They were unleashed in huge hordes across Bala Ged, leading to that land's consumption.

relations.note: each Titan spawned its own lineage
relations.quote: Each of the Eldrazi Titans on Zendikar spawned its own lineage
